messages:
maria: Quick Q — where's the canonical per-pool observability dashboard for Dedicated? I want to correlate GPU_util, pool_saturation, batching_concurrency, kv_cache_hit_ratio and autoscaler events for pool=eu-dedicated-a. Also want to propose alert tuning (saturation > 0.85 5m is noisy). I poked a draft in infra: https://git.redwood/infra/ops/123

dan: There's a Grafana view: Dedicated -> Per-pool overview. Use this link and set var-pool=eu-dedicated-a: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/pool-overview?var-pool=eu-dedicated-a. Panels you want: GPU util (per-GPU + avg), 95p latency (tokens/sec), queue depth, batching_effective_concurrency, kv_cache hit ratio, and autoscale_events timeline. For quick PromQL filtering use label `pool="eu-dedicated-a"`.

priya: PromQL snippets that are handy: ```
sum(rate(gpu_utilization_seconds_total{pool="eu-dedicated-a"}[5m])) by (instance)
max_over_time(pool_saturation{pool="eu-dedicated-a"}[10m])
sum(kv_cache_hits_total{pool="eu-dedicated-a"}) / sum(kv_cache_requests_total{pool="eu-dedicated-a"})
``` Also look at `pool_queue_depth` and `batching_effective_concurrency` panels — they show when batching is starving.

jonah: Reason for alert noise: autoscaler does very short bursts (scale up for 2–3min) which spike saturation briefly. Two quick fixes: make alert require sustained window (`for: 10m`) or AND it with a queue-wait signal. Example alert idea: `expr: pool_saturation > 0.85` AND `increase(pool_queue_waits_total{pool="eu-dedicated-a"}[10m]) > 3`. That reduces pager churn. Also consider soft alert on kv_cache_hit_ratio < 0.6 to warn before paging.

oncall-bot: Alert summary: pool_saturation_high eu-dedicated-a triggered at 1791999950 — autoscaler scaled 8 -> 12 GPUs. Link: https://alerts.redwood/alerts/98765

maria: Thanks — can someone open the infra PR to change saturation alert from 5m->10m and add the queue_waits condition? I'll update docs after the infra change.

dan: I'll open the PR now: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/456 — changes: add `for: 10m`, AND clause `increase(pool_queue_waits_total[10m]) > 3`, and add note in the dashboard description about how to interpret transient autoscale spikes.

priya: +1. Also add `kv_cache_hit_ratio < 0.6` as a soft (warning) signal so we don't page purely on short saturation when cache is starving.

maria: Perfect — leaving this with @jonah for a quick review once PR is up. :thumbsup:

jonah: Will review in the morning, please add a unit/test that simulates an autoscale event and a short burst so we don't regress.

maria: Thanks everyone, closing the async loop. :rocket:
